name: ArenaValueSet
description: A set of chosen values, carried by an event that reports a choice of many. An object holds the array, because an event's payload is a declared type or a primitive and never an array. A named set also says what the event carries.

values.description: The chosen values, each once, in the order they were chosen: a newly chosen value is appended and an unchosen one removed. A value matching nothing the component draws is kept.
